title: A young St. Augustine band playing old style
summary: Mrs. Henderson describes teenage musicians from St. Augustine playing old-style rather than bebop.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: They're a part of the musicians, or some of the St. Augustine musicians. I heard them practice Sunday. They practice over there, because the little boys are drummers. I mean youngster. But they really something good. You ought to hear them. They just start now. They all good. I mean, the singing and everything. They just start now. They got one elder man with them. He's a banjo player. But it's a little teenage. They're 18 and 17, 16. This little boy across the street is a drum. They play something. They were students from St. Augustine. Yeah. That's musicians up to date. Yeah, I mean up to date. They're looking up music of yesterday. Yeah. Historical musicians. Look up musicians that knew how to play. Everybody would be talking about. But they don't play rebob style.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: No, they don't play rebob style. You'd be surprised how you ought to come on. I guess we have a choice. As general boys play. I mean, for youngsters in St. Augustine, they are a genius. I mean, they haven't started jobs. Well, this little boy across the street, he teaches Mr. Barberin. Look, he had to join a union. He joined a union recently.
This little child. I don't know how many youngsters want to make a dick from that.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: But them little boys play. Suddenly, I'm telling you, they was playing. And I just couldn't sit still. I was cutting steps to old lady. Dance how much stuff she fell sitting down.
Me, Harold. So I was dancing. Carol and Codes and Mike Boxer and Amherst Space and I'd trip on them.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: I was just sitting. We keep still. Did you feel good, huh? Yeah, they play some good. Mm-hm. I think they played for the Holy Family, son. They did. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
